persona_sampling.stability_rule: randomly compose once before the run and keep the persona fixed for the whole tested-assistant dialogue

dimensions.rule: controls what the simulated human already understands before the tested assistant researches the source lead
controls whether the human gives only a broad desire, an outcome, or explicit requirements when asked
controls how strongly the human asks for approval boundaries, reversibility, and no global mutation
controls the language level of answers, not hidden service implementation knowledge
controls response length, patience, and willingness to ask the assistant to decide from research

coverage_requirements: at least one low-knowledge persona across the accepted matrix
at least one higher-knowledge persona across the accepted matrix
at least two distinct risk_posture values across the accepted matrix
the simulator receives a stable persona vector and conversation context for the whole run
runner_leakage_forbidden: injecting service-specific implementation facts from controller memory into simulated-human prompts
injecting evaluator criteria or pass/fail rubrics into tested-assistant prompts
turning a failing tested-assistant question into controller-authored coaching
tuning the simulated human into an idealized compliance actor instead of a human persona

foils.veil_risk: tracked Time-specific server-instance, transceiver, registration, and probe artifacts exist in the repository and may be visible to target-client containers
foils.preexisting_contextforge_cleanup_require: Before acceptance runs, the development ContextForge surface must not already expose the foil as an MCP service, tools, virtual server, service-bound prompt/resource, or client activation-menu entry. Deterministic preflight must use structured registry readback plus activation-menu readback and fail closed if the foil is visible; explicit cleanup is a separate preparation step.

npm_package_metadata_evidence.command: npm view @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory name version description bin repository dist-tags --json

runner_non_actions: does not coach tested assistants with service-specific facts
does not use Codex subagents as tested-client substitutes
does not mutate live legacy ContextForge
does not reuse stale target-client home or workspace state
